records.title: Multi-scale hypergraph meets LLMs: Aligning large language models for time series analysis
records.reason: The abstract aligns LLMs with multiscale time-series representations for forecasting; it does not present an inference efficiency method.

records.title: PAMAS: Self-Adaptive Multi-Agent System with Perspective Aggregation for Misinformation Detection
records.reason: The abstract proposes a multi-agent misinformation detection system and perspective aggregation; its focus is detection quality, not LLM inference efficiency.

records.title: FSVideo: Fast Speed Video Diffusion Model in a Highly-Compressed Latent Space
records.reason: The full paper is an image-to-video diffusion model with compressed visual latents and a layer-memory design; it does not concern language-model inference despite an incidental compiler-lineage link.

records.title: Scalable Spatio-Temporal SE(3) Diffusion for Long-Horizon Protein Dynamics
records.reason: The abstract presents a spatiotemporal diffusion model for protein molecular dynamics; the application and method are outside LLM inference.

records.title: When Domains Interact: Asymmetric and Order-Sensitive Cross-Domain Effects in Reinforcement Learning for Reasoning
records.reason: The abstract studies domain-order effects in GRPO training; its contribution concerns training sequence and reasoning accuracy, not inference-time cost or latency.
